comparison.admission: O(n^2) overlap checks,n<=4; fixed copied descriptors, no allocation.
comparison.poll: O(1) status/control work plus one next-descriptor configure; software SG contains a CPU scheduling gap.
comparison.cache: One clean per source/destination line, pre-invalidate destination and post-invalidate after quiescence; actual helper/provider imports retained.
comparison.peer: One HSEM take, fixed32-byte metadata maintenance and whole-payload receiver invalidation; bounded polling has no liveness/latency guarantee.

limits: Compiler local frames are observed, not full call-chain/interrupt peak stack.
No physical DMA duration, cache/interconnect bandwidth, peer latency or energy measurement.
Rebuild after target/optimization changes; costs are not portable golden outputs.
